summary: Established GA-grade release discipline. Implemented repo integrity checks (script + CI), enforced Prisma migration policy (migrations required, db push disabled), and set up strict release build gates (lint/test/build/integrity) in CI.

major_decisions.decision: Implemented a custom lightweight Node.js script for integrity checks.
major_decisions.reason: Allows fast, cross-platform checking of null bytes, critical files, and JSON validity without heavy dependencies.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Custom script requires maintenance, but is faster than installing heavy linters just for file existence/corruption checks.

major_decisions.decision: Disabled `db push` via script wrapper and documented strict migration policy.
major_decisions.reason: Release stability requires reproducible database states which `db push` cannot guarantee.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Developers must learn to use `prisma migrate dev`, which is slightly more friction but safer.

major_decisions.reason: The workspace was not a git repo, which blocked integrity checks and CI workflows.

build_gates.name: Root Build
build_gates.notes: apps/api, shared built successfully. apps/web failed/timed out during Next.js build. Gate correctly caught this.

errors.how_fixed_or_next_steps: Investigate apps/web configuration or dependencies. Build gate blocked release.

policy_summary.db_migration_policy: Strict `prisma migrate dev` only. No `db push`.
policy_summary.integrity_policy: CI fails on any null byte or missing critical file.
policy_summary.release_gates_policy: Lint, Test, Build, and Integrity must pass.
